body:
Can confirm the issue is present in the MRP, and is fixed when you change the TileMapLayer's filter to `Nearest` instead of `Inherit`.

The TileMapLayer's `texture_filter` *should* inherit from the default Viewport's `canvas-item-default-texture-filter` ([docs](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/classes/class_viewport.html#class-viewport-property-canvas-item-default-texture-filter)), and `canvas-item-default-texture-filter` inherits from **Project Settings > Rendering > Textures > Canvas Textures > Default Texture Filter**. 

When you run the scene and examine in the Remote pane, the Viewport setting is inheriting from the ProjectSettings as expected, but TileMapLayer is not inheriting this in the previews specifically.

Another note: if TileMapLayer's parent is *not* set to **Inherit** and is instead set explicitly to **Nearest**, then the TileMapLayer preview displays as expected with Nearest neighbor filtering.
